name: EDA-6
summary: 3,4-Ethylenedioxyamphetamine (EDA), also known as EDA-6, is a drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and EDxx families related to 3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA). It is closely related to analogues including 3,4-ethylenedioxymethamphetamine (EDMA), 3,4-ethylidenedioxyamphetamine (EIDA), and 3,4-isopropylidenedioxyamphetamine (IDA).

pharmacology.text: EDMA, the N-methylated analogue of EDA, is known to be a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA).
